question: According to the Census of India 2011, in which of the following states was Scheduled Caste population NOT recorded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

__
 
• **Nagaland **is one of the states in India with a population of 1978502.
 
• There are **11 districts**, 114 Taluks, 1428 villages, and 26 towns in Nagaland.
 
• As per the Census India 2011, Nagaland has **396002 households, a population of 1978502 of which 1024649 are males and 953853 are females**.
 
• The population of children between ages 0-6 is 291071 which is 14.71% of the total population.
 
• Out of the total population, 71.14% of the population live in urban areas and 28.86% live in rural areas.
 
• **There is 0 Scheduled Caste (SC) and 86.48% Scheduled Tribe (ST) of the total population in Nagaland**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The total population of India reached 121 crores (1.21 billion)
 
• The total number of males was 62.31 crores and females were 58.74 crores.
 
• The percentage of population growth during the decade was 17.7%.
 
• Sex ratio was 943 females/1000 males
 
• Child sex ratio was 919 females/1000 males
 
• **State with highest sex ratio** – Kerala (1084 females/1000 males)
 
• **UT with highest sex ratio **– Puducherry (1029 females/1000 males)
 
• **State with lowest sex ratio **– Haryana (877 females/1000 males)
 
• **UT with lowest sex ratio** – Daman and Diu (618 females/1000 males) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are **7.15% Scheduled Caste** (SC) and 12.45% Scheduled Tribe (ST) of the total population in **Assam**.
 
• There are** 4.63% Scheduled Caste** (SC) and 33.8% Scheduled Tribe (ST) of the total population in **Sikkim**.
 
• There are **17.83% Scheduled Caste **(SC) and 31.76% Scheduled Tribe (ST) of the total population in **Tripura**.
 
• There are** 0.11% Scheduled Caste **(SC) and 94.43% Scheduled Tribe (ST) of the total population in** Mizoram**.
